statement_scope: For fixed real h,j,sigma,Lambda,eta and every finite normalization threshold, realAmplitude has no positive lower bound uniform over all C above that threshold.
proof_method: Choose C=max(threshold+1, 2*exp(Lambda*realPhase)/m+1) to contradict any proposed positive lower bound m.
limitations: This is a nonuniformity result over all admissible large normalizations, not a claim that the selected finite AxisStage amplitude is zero or small.
It does not establish a counterexample or a negative pressure-moment sign for FinalSlowBase.actualProfile.
The extension ran in the pinned Lean checker container; this was not an upstream OpenAI source modification.
